recipes.title: Easy Shakshuka
ingredients: 1 large red bell pepper or roasted red bell pepper, chopped
¼ teaspoon red pepper flakes, reduce or omit if sensitive to spice
1 large can (28 ounces) crushed tomatoes, preferably fire-roasted
2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro or flat-leaf parsley, plus addition cilantro or parsley leaves for garnish
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
Crusty bread or pita, for serving
recipes.description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato-and-pepper sauce, finished with crumbled feta.

recipes.title: Carbonara (real)
ingredients: 175g/6 oz guanciale (pancetta or block bacon), ( weight after skin removed (Note 1))
100g/3.5 oz parmigiano reggiano (, finely shredded (or pecorino romano, sub parmesan, Note 3))
recipes.description: Traditional Roman pasta made creamy with egg, cheese and guanciale, with no cream.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Chicken Fajitas
recipes.description: Chicken, peppers and onions roasted together with smoky fajita spice and served in tortillas.

recipes.title: Butter Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 tsp chilli powder or cayenne pepper powder ((Note 2))
1.5 lb / 750 g chicken thigh fillets, cut into bite size pieces
2 tbsp (30 g) ghee or butter, ( OR 1 tbsp vegetable oil (Note 3))
recipes.description: Chicken simmered in a mild, creamy spiced tomato sauce (murgh makhani).

recipes.title: Kung Pao Chicken Recipe - Chinese Restaurant Quality
ingredients: 1 cup raw peanuts ((shelled, with or without the skin))
6 scallions ((white portions only, cut into 3/4-inch/2cm pieces)
recipes.description: Sichuan stir-fry of diced chicken, peanuts and dried chilies in a tangy-savory sauce.

recipes.title: Pad Thai
ingredients: 125 g / 4oz Chang's Pad Thai dried rice sticks ((Note 1))
150 g/5oz chicken breast (or thigh) (, thinly sliced)
1/2 cup firm tofu, cut into 3cm / 1 1/4" batons (see photo)
1/4 cup garlic chives , cut into 3cm / 1 1/4" pieces
recipes.description: Rice-noodle stir-fry with tamarind sauce, egg, tofu, bean sprouts and crushed peanuts.

recipes.title: Bulgogi (Korean BBQ Beef)
ingredients: 2 pounds thinly-sliced beef (rib eye or top sirloin) - see note
4 tablespoons sugar (or you can use 2 T sugar 2 T honey) (Use 3 T total for less sweetness)
2 tablespoons minced garlic (about 5 to 6 plump cloves)
1/2 Korean/Asian pear, blended/grated (or bosc pear or apple (sweet variety-honey crisp, Fuji, red delicious, etc.) )
3 ounces potato starch noodles (soaked in hot water for 20 minutes and drained)
2 cups water, dashima broth, or beef broth
recipes.description: Thin slices of beef marinated in a sweet-savory soy sauce base, then quickly seared.

recipes.title: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 3/4 cup (170g/12 Tbsp) unsalted butter, melted & cooled for 5 minutes
3/4 cup (150g) packed light or dark brown sugar
1 large egg + 1 egg yolk, at room temperature
1 and 1/4 cups (225g) semi-sweet chocolate chips or chocolate chunks
recipes.description: Thick, chewy cookies using melted butter, cornstarch and an extra egg yolk.

recipes.title: Simple, Fluffy Pancakes
ingredients: 4 tsp baking powder (NOT baking soda / bi-carb (Note 1))
1/4 cup white sugar ((caster / super fine is best but not essential))
1 3/4 cups cups milk ((any type, any fat %))
recipes.description: A simple no-fail batter for soft, tall stovetop pancakes.

recipes.title: Best Hummus
ingredients: 1 can (15 ounces) chickpeas, rinsed and drained, or 1 ½ cups cooked chickpeas
½ teaspoon baking soda (if you’re using canned chickpeas)
¼ cup lemon juice (from 1 ½ to 2 lemons), more to taste
½ teaspoon fine sea salt, to taste
2 to 4 tablespoons ice water, more as needed
Any of the following garnishes: drizzle of olive oil or zhoug sauce, sprinkle of ground sumac or paprika, chopped fresh parsley
recipes.description: Ultra-smooth blended chickpea and tahini dip finished with olive oil.

recipes.title: Thai Green Curry
ingredients: 4 - 6 tbsp Thai Green Curry Paste (Maesri best) OR ((Note 1))
1 cup (250ml) chicken or vegetable broth, low sodium
6 kaffir lime leaves (, torn in half (Note 5))
350 g/12 oz chicken thigh (, skinless boneless, sliced (Note 6))
Crispy fried Asian shallots (, high recommended (Note 9))
Green or red chillies slices (, optional)
recipes.description: A coconut-milk curry built by frying green curry paste with vegetables and chicken.

recipes.title: Best Guacamole
ingredients: 4 medium ripe avocados, halved and pitted
½ cup finely chopped white onion (about ½ small onion)
¼ cup finely chopped fresh cilantro
1 small jalapeño, seeds and ribs removed, finely chopped
3 tablespoons lime juice (from about 1 ½ limes), or more if needed
1 teaspoon kosher salt, more to taste
recipes.description: Fresh avocado dip with onion, cilantro, jalapeño, lime and a touch of ground coriander.

recipes.title: Homemade Chili Recipe
recipes.description: Ground beef and two-bean chili in a spiced tomato base.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken
ingredients: 2 thigh fillets ( skin on, bone removed (about 350g/12oz in total, note 1))
a sprig of parsley or mint ((optional))
recipes.description: Pan-cooked chicken glazed in a simple homemade soy-mirin-sake teriyaki sauce.

recipes.title: Vegan Overnight Oats
ingredients: 1 ½ cups almond or oat milk
pinch of sea salt (if pb is unsalted)
Toppings of choice: drizzle of peanut butter (banana slices and berries)
recipes.description: Vegan overnight oats with dairy-free milk, peanut butter, chia, maple syrup, fruit, and optional protein powder.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Salmon recipe
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets ((180g/6oz each), skinless and boneless)
1 tbsp garlic (~2 cloves) (, finely minced by hand (don't use a garlic press))
90g / 6 tbsp salted butter (, cut into cubes (or unsalted + 1/4 tsp salt))
1 tsp lemon juice (, plus more to taste)
recipes.description: Salmon fillets seared and continuously basted in garlic butter.

recipes.title: Quick Chana Masala
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked brown basmati rice, for serving (rice is optional, I like to cook extra to have on hand for other meals)
2 tablespoons coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil
1 medium serrano or jalapeño pepper*, minced (remove ribs and seeds to tame the spice level)
½ teaspoon fine sea salt, to taste
5 cloves garlic, pressed or minced (about 1 tablespoon)
1 tablespoon peeled and minced fresh ginger (about a 1-inch piece)
1 large can (28 ounces) fire-roasted crushed tomatoes or whole peeled tomatoes, with their juices
2 cans (14 ounces each) chickpeas (or 3 cups cooked chickpeas), rinsed and drained
recipes.description: Chickpeas simmered in a spiced tomato sauce, served over basmati rice.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Pho recipe
ingredients: 1kg / 2lb marrow bones ((leg, knuckle), cut to reveal marrow)
30g / 1 oz beef tenderloin, raw, very thinly sliced ((Note 4))
recipes.description: Beef noodle soup with a long-simmered, spice-infused clear broth and fresh toppings.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1.25 kg / 2.5 lb brown / yellow onions (, peeled, halved, thinly sliced top to bottom (Note 1))
1.5 litres / 6 cups / 1.5 quarts good quality beef broth./stock OR chicken (, low sodium/salt reduced (Note 3))
6 - 8 slices French baguette (or other softish bread (Note 4))
100 g / 3.5 oz gruyere (or mozzarella cheese, or other melting cheese of choice)
Fresh parsley or thyme leaves (, for garnish (optional))
recipes.description: Deeply caramelized-onion soup topped with cheesy toasted bread.

recipes.title: Seriously Fudgy Homemade Brownies
ingredients: 3/4 cup (12 Tbsp; 170g) unsalted butter, sliced into 12 Tbsp-size pieces
4 ounces (113g) semi-sweet chocolate, coarsely chopped and divided*
1 cup (84g) unsweetened natural or Dutch-process cocoa powder*
recipes.description: Dense, rich brownies with a triple hit of cocoa, melted chocolate and chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Baked Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 3 cups milk (, warmed (low or full fat))
2 cups freshly shredded cheese, gruyere best ((followed by cheddar and Colby) (Note 2))
1 cup freshly shredded mozzarella cheese (, or more other cheese of choice (Note 2))
recipes.description: Creamy roux-based macaroni cheese with a crunchy panko-butter topping.

recipes.title: Carnitas (Mexican Slow Cooker Pulled Pork)
ingredients: 2 kg / 4 lb pork shoulder (pork butt) (, skinless, boneless (5lb/2.5kg bone in) (Note 1))
recipes.description: Slow-cooked pulled pork crisped in a pan, seasoned with orange, cumin and oregano.

recipes.title: Ratatouille
ingredients: 2 pounds ripe red tomatoes (6 medium or 4 large)
1 medium eggplant (1 pound), diced into ½-inch cubes
1 large red, orange, or yellow bell pepper (about 8 ounces), cut into ¾-inch squares
1 medium-to-large zucchini (about 8 ounces), diced into ½-inch cubes
1 large yellow squash (about 8 ounces), diced into ½-inch cubes
5 tablespoons + 1 teaspoon extra-virgin olive oil, divided
¾ teaspoon fine sea salt, divided, more to taste
¼ teaspoon red pepper flakes, more or less to taste
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
recipes.description: Roasted summer vegetables simmered into a rustic tomato stew.

recipes.title: Greek Salad (Traditional Horiatiki Recipe)
ingredients: 1 medium red onion, (thinly sliced into half moons)
4 medium juicy tomatoes, (sliced into bite-sized pieces or wedges)
1 English cucumber, (partially peeled to make a striped pattern and sliced into half moons)
1 green bell pepper, (cored and sliced into rings)
1 (7 ounce) block Greek feta cheese in brine, (torn into slabs)
recipes.description: A chunky, lettuce-free salad of tomato, cucumber, pepper, olives and feta with oregano.

recipes.title: Classic Minestrone Soup
ingredients: 2 cups chopped seasonal vegetables (potatoes, yellow squash, zucchini, butternut squash, green beans or peas all work)
1 large can (28 ounces) diced tomatoes, with their liquid (or 2 small 15-ounce cans)
1 cup orecchiette, elbow or small shell pasta
1 can (15 ounces) Great Northern beans or cannellini beans, rinsed and drained, or 1 ½ cups cooked beans
2 cups baby spinach, chopped kale or chopped collard greens
Freshly grated Parmesan cheese, for garnishing (optional)
recipes.description: A hearty vegetable, bean and pasta soup in a tomato broth.

recipes.title: One Pot Mexican Chicken and Rice
ingredients: 2 tsp garlic powder ((or 2 garlic cloves, minced))
5 chicken thighs, bone-in, skin on ( (Notes 2 and 3))
1 small onion (, peeled and diced (or 1/2 large))
1 red capsicum ((bell pepper), diced or sliced)
1 cup chicken stock/broth (, low sodium (or vegetable stock))
1 cup frozen corn kernels ((or canned - drained))
1 can (400g/16oz) black beans (, drained and rinsed (sub red kidney beans))
recipes.description: Fajita-spiced chicken baked over Mexican red rice with peppers, corn, black beans, and lime.

recipes.title: Jambalaya Recipe (easy)
ingredients: 200g (7oz) andouille or smoked sausage (, sliced 0.5cm / 1/5" thick (Note 1))
300g (10oz) chicken thigh (, skinless boneless, cut into 2.5cm /1" pieces)
12 prawns/shrimp (, raw, large, (peeled, with or without tails))
1 onion (, large, cut into 1.5 cm / 0.5" pieces)
2 celery ribs (, cut into 1.5 cm / 0.5" pieces)
2 green capsicum / bell pepper (, medium, cut into 1.5 cm / 0.5" pieces)
1 cup green onions (, sliced, plus more for serving)
2 tsp chopped fresh thyme ((or 1 tsp dried thyme))
1/2 tsp cayenne powder ((adjust spice to taste))
recipes.description: Creole-style baked rice with chicken, smoked sausage, bacon, shrimp, vegetables, and Cajun spices.

recipes.title: Vegetarian enchiladas
ingredients: 2-3 tsp chilli powder (mild or hot, according to your taste)
2 x 400g cans pulses in water, drained (we used mixed beans and lentils)
50g extra-mature cheddar cheese (or veg alternative), finely grated
recipes.description: Whole-wheat tortillas filled with beans, lentils, vegetables, and tomato sauce, then topped with yogurt and cheese.

recipes.title: Green Ginger Rice Noodles
ingredients: 350g / 3 cups shredded cooked chicken ((I use my foolproof poached chicken))
4 cups (lightly packed) green onion (, cut into ~1.25cm / 1/2" pieces (5 - 6 BIG stems!))
2 tbsp light soy sauce (, or all-purpose soy sauce (not dark soy sauce - Note 2))
1 tsp cooking salt / kosher salt ((halve for table salt, +50% for flakes))
1/3 cup grapeseed oil (, or other neutral flavoured oil (vegetable, canola etc))
Sriracha - use as much as you dare!
recipes.description: Rice noodles and shredded chicken tossed in a vivid green onion, ginger, garlic, soy, and rice-vinegar sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken satay curry
ingredients: 2 tbsp mild or medium curry powder
500g skinless, boneless chicken thighs cut into bite-sized pieces
50g salted or roasted peanuts roughly chopped
recipes.description: A creamy coconut and peanut chicken curry with green beans, peppers, and a savoury satay-style sauce.

recipes.title: Salmon risotto
ingredients: 1 garlic clove crushed or finely grated
50g parmesan grated, plus extra to serve
recipes.description: A creamy lemon and Parmesan risotto finished with peas and tender poached salmon.

recipes.title: Coconut Curried Kale and Sweet Potato
ingredients: 1 ½ cups brown basmati rice, rinsed well
1 teaspoon fine salt, divided, more to taste
2 pounds sweet potato (about 3 medium) or 1 butternut squash, peeled and sliced into ½-inch cubes
3 large garlic cloves, pressed or minced
1 large bunch of kale (about 8 ounces), stems removed and chopped
1 can (14 ounces) full-fat coconut milk, divided
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
recipes.description: A hearty vegan curry of sweet potato, kale, coconut milk, ginger, warm spices, lime, and brown basmati rice.

recipes.title: Lamb tagine
ingredients: 1.6 kg/ 3.2lb boneless lamb shoulder, trim the fat, then ( cut in 3.5cm / 1.5" cubes (1kg/2lb after trimming))
1 kg / 2 lb lamb stewing meat or shoulder, already trimmed of fat (cut in 3.5cm / 1.5" cubes)
1 cup dried apricots (, whole (Note 2 for olives option))
2 - 3 tsp lemon zest ((just use 1 whole lemon, Note 3 for preserved lemon))
1 tsp cayenne pepper ((can reduce for less spicy - Note 4))
1 1/2 batches couscous ((I just use plain, but you can add the fruit and nuts if you want))
recipes.description: Fork-tender lamb shoulder slow-cooked with ras el hanout, apricots, lemon, and toasted almonds.

recipes.title: Most Delicious Falafel Recipe (Fried or Baked)
ingredients: 1 cup dried chickpeas (soaked overnight (don't use canned chickpeas))
1 cup roughly chopped parsley (about a one large bunch)
1 cup roughly chopped cilantro (about a one large bunch)
1 small green chile pepper (serrano or jalapeno pepper)
recipes.description: Naturally vegan falafel made with soaked chickpeas, parsley, cilantro, onion, garlic, green chile, and warm spices.

recipes.title: Baked Cod Recipe with Lemon and Garlic
recipes.description: Flaky cod coated with coriander, paprika, and cumin, then baked in a bright lemon, garlic, and olive-oil sauce.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 1 cup cooked pinto beans or black beans (I used canned beans, rinsed and drained)
Several dashes of hot sauce, such as Cholula
⅔ cup (packed) shredded sharp cheddar cheese
½ cup chopped green onion (mostly green parts), divided
6 tablespoons of your favorite salsa, plus extra for serving
1 large avocado, diced (optional, if you’re serving the burritos right away)
recipes.description: Whole-grain tortillas filled with eggs, beans, hash browns, cheddar, cilantro, green onion, and salsa.

recipes.title: Harissa fish with bulgur salad
ingredients: ½ small cucumber deseeded and finely chopped
small handful of parsley finely chopped
2 x 120g skinless, boneless white fish fillets, such as cod or haddock
recipes.description: Harissa-coated white fish served with a lemony bulgur salad containing vegetables and olives.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Mexican Chicken Soup
ingredients: 800g / 28 oz canned black beans, drained ((2 cans, or other beans, Note 1))
800g / 28 oz canned corn, drained ((2 cans, or 500g/1lb frozen or fresh corn))
1 tsp each onion powder and garlic powder ((or 2 tsp of one of them))
Corn chips or tortillas (, for dunking)
recipes.description: A slow-cooked Mexican chicken soup with beans, corn, tomatoes, chipotle, lime, and shredded chicken.

recipes.title: Spicy Tuna Guacamole Bowls
ingredients: 2 5oz. cans chunk light tuna in water ($1.60)
recipes.description: Rice bowls layered with tuna, edamame, cucumber, carrot, guacamole, cilantro, and sriracha.

recipes.title: Chicken and Lime Soup
ingredients: 2 10oz. cans diced tomatoes with green chiles (Rotel) ($0.90)
recipes.description: A bright and tangy chicken soup with tomatoes, jalapeño, cilantro, vegetables, and fresh lime.

recipes.title: Curried Chickpeas with Spinach
recipes.description: Chickpeas and spinach cooked in a quick tomato curry with ginger, garlic, onion, and spices.

recipes.title: Moroccan Lentil and Vegetable Soup
recipes.description: A vegetable-rich lentil and chickpea soup seasoned with cumin, turmeric, cinnamon, and cayenne.

recipes.title: Best Winter Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1½ pound cubed kabocha or butternut squash
5 tablespoons tomato paste ((3 oz, or 1/2 a can))
1 large onion ((1 large onion = about 8 oz/225g, diced))
½ cup yellow split peas ((rinsed and drained))
recipes.description: A nourishing vegan soup with winter vegetables, yellow split peas, tomato, herbs, and vegetable stock.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 8 tortillas (, flour or corn (about 20cm/8" wide, Note 1))
1 tsp EACH onion powder, garlic powder, salt
1 tbsp EACH dried cumin powder, paprika, dried oregano
3/4 tsp cayenne pepper ((optional, adjust to taste))
1.5 cups (375ml) tomato passata or US puree ((Note 4 sub))
600g / 1.2lb chicken breast (, sliced in half horizontally (or boneless thigh) (Note 2))
1 cup (100g) cheese (shredded (Mexican cheese blend, Monterey Jack, cheddar))
recipes.description: Juicy seasoned chicken and beans rolled in tortillas, covered with homemade enchilada sauce and melted cheese.

recipes.title: Farro Salad Recipe
ingredients: 1 bunch lacinato kale ( 8-10 ounces), finely chopped, about 4-5 cups.
1 bunch flat-leaf parsley, very finely chopped ( tender stems, OK) about 1-2 cups
1/2 cup – 1 cup toasted almonds, chopped, slivered, or sliced
1 tablespoon lemon juice, and more to taste
recipes.description: A festive vegan farro salad with kale, parsley, pomegranate, toasted almonds, lemon, allspice, and cinnamon.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Blueberry Pancakes
ingredients: 2 cups (260g) whole wheat flour or white whole wheat flour (spooned & leveled)
1 cup (248g) plain Greek yogurt, at room temperature*
1 and 1/4 cups (300ml) milk, at room temperature*
1/4 cup (60ml) pure maple syrup, at room temperature*
3 Tablespoons (42g) coconut oil, melted (or vegetable oil, or melted butter)
1 and 3/4 cups (245g) frozen or fresh blueberries*
for cooking: nonstick cooking spray or butter
recipes.description: Fluffy whole-wheat pancakes packed with blueberries, Greek yogurt, milk, maple syrup, and cinnamon.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Protein Bars (Vegan + Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 cup old fashioned rolled oats (or quick oats)
1 cup vanilla protein powder (vegan if needed)
1 cup canned pumpkin or homemade pumpkin puree
½ cup oat milk (or other non-dairy milk)
recipes.description: Vegan pumpkin protein bars with oats, plant protein powder, pumpkin, maple syrup, spices, and dairy-free chocolate.

recipes.title: Easy Egg Muffins (3 Ways)
ingredients: kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper (to taste)
recipes.description: Meal-prep egg muffins with three savory combinations of vegetables, cheese, bacon, or sausage.

recipes.title: No-Bake Chocolate Fudge Oat Bars
ingredients: 1/2 cup (125g) crunchy or creamy peanut butter
1 and 1/4 cups (106g) old-fashioned whole rolled oats
3/4 cup (about 100-120g) add-ins (such as salted or unsalted peanuts and raisins, see Note)
optional: 1 Tablespoon unsweetened shredded coconut for topping
recipes.description: Chewy no-bake oat bars with chocolate, peanut butter, maple syrup, crisp rice cereal, nuts, and raisins.
